newsitem.title: USA: Kerr-McGee sees Garden Banks at 60 mln mcf/d in 98.
newsitem.headline: Kerr-McGee sees Garden Banks at 60 mln mcf/d in 98.

text.p: Kerr-McGee Corp said on Wednesday that its Garden Banks 65 field in the Gulf of Mexico will be producing 60 million cubic feet of natural gas per day when it starts operation in mid-1998.

The company said in a statement that the development included blocks East Cameron 373 and Garden Banks 21 and 22 and that Kerr McGee would use a production platform owned by Leviathan Gas Pipeline Partners, L.P. in order to reduce costs.
Kerr-McGee has 60 percent interest in the field and Newfield Exploration Co the remainder.
Kerr-McGee's lease inventory in the Gulf of Mexico consists of more than 200 blocks in state and federal waters. ((-- New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
